image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, navigating through dry grass and twigs. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace that appears smooth but slightly textured with age or sediment. Its head is extended, revealing a greyish-brown neck with rough skin texture and a distinct eye. One front limb is visible, showing dark scales and claws gripping the ground. The plastron is partially visible along the lower edge, appearing yellowish-orange.
